operating_notes.text: Received ₹130.10 Cr settlement from NHAI for Madurai-Ramanathapuram and Pollachi-Coimbatore sections of NH 83.
Received ₹32.87 Cr claim settlement (including ₹6.89 Cr interest) from NHAI for Hubli-Hospet section of NH-63.
Completed sale of KNR Palani Infra Private Limited to Indus Infra Trust for ₹205.05 Cr with ₹90 Cr cash upstreamed.
Total order book stands at ₹11,903 Cr as of March 31, 2026, including two new HAM projects worth ₹3,897 Cr.
Net working capital days stood at 96 days as of June 30, 2026.
Total order book stood at ₹8,667.4 Cr as of June 30, 2026, with an additional ₹6,566.6 Cr of newly won projects pending inclusion.
Consolidated debt stood at ₹1,975 Cr as of June 30, 2026.
Secured ₹157.55 Cr EPC order from Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation with a 24-month execution period.
Completed sale of 100% equity in KNR Guruvayur Infra Pvt Ltd to Indus Infra Trust for ₹485.86 Cr against ₹193.32 Cr invested capital.
Received order from CIT (Appeals) deleting ₹18.22 Cr penalty for AY 2007-08.
Received search-related penalty orders under Section 270A totaling ₹91.85 Cr for AY 2017-18 to AY 2020-21 from ACIT Central Circle 2(2) Hyderabad.
Extended completion timeline for sale of 100% stake in KNR Ramanattukara Infra Private Limited to Indus Infra Trust to 31st December 2026 due to delayed condition precedents.
Received CIT-Appeals order deleting ₹18.58 Cr penalty under section 271AAD for AY 2021-22.
Achieved financial closure for 80.01 km NH-167 HAM project in Telangana on 01 October 2026.

timeline.summary: Received ₹130.10 Cr from NHAI as settlement for claims related to two NH 83 highway projects.
Received ₹32.87 Cr (including ₹6.89 Cr interest) from NHAI as settlement for claims on the Hubli-Hospet section of NH-63.
Promoter K Narsimha Reddy declares no pledge or encumbrance on promoter group shares as of April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹695.59 Cr, net profit ₹106.1 Cr (includes ₹12.48 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹93.62 Cr).
2026-05-29: Completed transfer of entire equity share capital in subsidiary KNR Palani Infra Private Limited to Indus Infra Trust for ₹205.05 Cr.
KNR Constructions Limited’s **Haritha Varanasi** uploaded the earnings call recording on June 1, 2026, via the company website.
KNR Constructions hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on June 1, 2026, reporting an order book of ₹11,903 Cr and guiding for 10%-11% EBITDA margins.
CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed KNR Constructions' long-term rating at CRISIL AA/Stable and short-term rating at CRISIL A1+.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹587.94 Cr (-4.0% YoY), net profit ₹80.72 Cr (-34.6% YoY) (includes ₹7.15 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹73.57 Cr).
KNR Constructions published its revised Q1FY27 investor presentation, highlighting a ₹3,361 Cr coal mining LOA win and ₹8,667 Cr order book.
KNR Constructions Limited’s Haritha Varanasi, Company Secretary, uploaded earnings call recording on 14th August 2026 via company website.
KNR Constructions hosted its Q1FY27 earnings call on August 14, 2026, guiding for FY27 revenue of ₹2,200 Cr to ₹2,300 Cr.
KNR Constructions received a ₹157.55 Cr EPC order from Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation for flyovers and an underpass in Banjara Hills.
KNR Constructions completed the transfer of SPV KNR Guruvayur Infra to Indus Infra Trust for ₹485.86 Cr.
Office of CIT (Appeals) deleted a tax penalty of ₹18.22 Cr against KNR Constructions for AY 2007-08.
KNR Constructions Limited received order from Commissioner of Income Tax – Appeals, Hyderabad-12 deleting penalty of ₹93,544,336 for AY 2021-22 on 2026-09-23.

KNR Constructions Limited’s 31st AGM on September 25, 2026, passed all resolutions with required majorities via remote e-voting and physical attendance, as certified by Scrutinizer Vikas Sirohiya (P S Rao and Associates).
KNR Constructions extended the expected completion date for selling its stake in KNR Ramanattukara Infra Private Limited to October 15, 2026.
Extended the target date for completing the sale of its stake in KNR Ramanattukara Infra Private Limited to Indus Infra Trust to December 31, 2026.
KNR Constructions received an appellate order deleting a tax penalty of ₹18.58 Cr for AY 2021-22.
KNR Constructions Limited informed the exchanges about the revocation of a ₹157.55 Cr Letter of Acceptance from GHMC for a flyover and underpass project in Telangana.
KNR Constructions subsidiary KNR Manyamkonda Infra achieved financial closure for an 80 km NH-167 HAM project in Telangana.
